create_openai_client: create an OpenAI client configured with a HuggingFace router base URL and HF_TOKEN API key
create_chat_completion: create a chat completion call to a vision-language model using the OpenAI Python SDK
create_multimodal_message: create a multimodal message with text and image_url content for a vision-language model
create_vision_instruct_request: create a vision-instruct request to describe an image using Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct
read_completion_response: read the first choice message from a chat completion response object
